title: CouncilConfig
description: Configuration for the henka-council governance layer (.council/config.json).

target_project.description: Name or path of the target project being governed.

autonomy_level.description: Nominal autonomy level (0–5). Subject to dynamic floor (R10).

review_frequency.description: How often the council convenes for review.

cycle_length.description: Number of sprints per PDCA cycle. Default 5.

dispatch_mode.description: Agent dispatch mode. Sequential by default in v0.1.

andon_takt_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds for andon alert swarm resolution. Default 600.

dynamic_autonomy_thresholds.description: Thresholds governing dynamic autonomy floor drops (R10).

consecutive_fail_count.description: Number of consecutive sprint FAILs before floor drops. Default 2.

andon_stop_consecutive_count.description: Number of consecutive andon-stop events before floor drop. Default 3.

andon_stop_distinct_originators_required.description: Distinct originator agents required for andon-stop floor drop trigger. Default 2.

halt_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger a halt in the autorun loop.

custom_henkaten_categories.description: Project-specific custom sub-types beyond the built-in 13.

category_id.description: Unique identifier for this custom category.

fourM_axis.description: Primary 4M axis for this custom category.

irreversible_overrides.description: Commands moved out of the reversibility denylist with Level 5 ratification.
